title: Adobe Firefly Adds Design and Workflow Tools in Beta
summary: Adobe Firefly adds new design and workflow tools in beta release
detailed: Adobe is expanding Firefly with Firefly Design (beta), a shared canvas for creative work, and Firefly Graph (beta), which lets users build workflows they can run repeatedly.
Firefly Design (beta) combines image editing and illustration with tools for print, animation and 3D, supporting projects such as brand identities and social campaigns through review.
Firefly Graph (beta) connects AI models with Adobe production tools, with an AI Assistant helping users construct and refine workflows.

In Firefly Builder (private beta), users can change individual elements on the canvas, while a design system helps keep the project consistent.
sentences: Adobe is expanding Firefly with Firefly Design (beta), a shared canvas for creative work, and Firefly Graph (beta), which lets users build workflows they can run repeatedly.
Creative Cloud is also getting broader AI assistance, with beta assistants accepting written instructions for tasks involving multiple steps.
Connections allowing outside agents to edit local Creative Cloud projects are in preview, with a private beta planned for early 2027.

Access differs for Firefly Builder (private beta), which turns written requests into interactive prototypes for apps, websites or presentations without requiring code for the first version.

In Firefly Builder (private beta), users can change individual elements on the canvas, while a design system helps keep the project consistent.
For Creative Cloud users, the planned local agent connections preserve editable project components, including layers and sequences, and allow users to take over manually.
Adobe is extending those connections to Photoshop and Premiere as well as After Effects and Illustrator.

The Adobe Creative Agent supports expanded beta AI Assistants in applications including InDesign, Illustrator and Premiere; Photoshop users access its AI Assistant through the application's beta version.
Editing additions include Photoshop's Relight and Generative Restyle, alongside Premiere's Color Mode.
Adobe is also adding Open Eyes (beta) to Lightroom and Co-editing (beta) to InDesign.

For marketing teams, Adobe plans to add CX Enterprise Coworker to GenStudio, letting users request campaign work through conversation while it coordinates agents across planning, production and activation.
Intelligent Reflow will bring guidance on brand standards into applications including GenStudio and Photoshop.
Workfront is getting Ideation Space, a collaborative canvas intended to turn creative input, performance information and context collected by Coworker into campaign briefs.
The expansion follows initial releases that began on November 10, including Premiere Color Mode and a licensed music catalog for Premiere Mobile whose tracks are limited to non-commercial use.

Earlier this year, Anthropic released Adobe for creativity, a Claude connector that could coordinate work across Adobe applications, with account sign-in providing additional tools, higher usage limits and saving between sessions.
